title: Companies must govern WhatsApp groups internally; new admin rights allow muting
content_md:
Companies must now govern WhatsApp groups internally in line with their policies. New administrator rights allow muting.

via Mastodon https://www.ctsd.de/insights/2026-11-technik-whatsapp-neufunktionen-was-unternehmen-wissen-m-ssen.html
exclude_reason: Product-administration commentary about WhatsApp group controls, not a security event or vulnerability.
